name: Low Oxygen Affinity Alpha Chain Hemoglobin Disease
aliases: Hemoglobin Alpha Chain Low Oxygen Affinity Variant
Alpha Chain Hemoglobinopathy with Reduced Oxygen Affinity

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Low Oxygen Affinity Hemoglobinopathy Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of mild compensated hemolytic anemia with cyanosis
Identification of alpha chain hemoglobin variant with decreased oxygen affinity by hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC
Demonstration of a left-shifted oxygen dissociation curve indicating low oxygen affinity
Detection of pathogenic mutation in alpha globin gene (HBA1 or HBA2)
Exclusion of other causes of hemolytic anemia and cyanosis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria (clinical presentation, hemoglobin analysis, and oxygen dissociation curve) must be met for diagnosis.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing supports diagnosis but is not mandatory.

pathognomonic.notes: Central cyanosis due to reduced oxygen saturation despite normal lung function
Typically asymptomatic or mild anemia with reticulocytosis
